basic_details.job_title: THSTI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Research Associate, Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: THSTI will hold walk-in interviews at 9:00 am at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001: on 23 November 2026 for Project Associate-I and on 27 November 2026 for Research Associate-I. There is one post each. Pay is Rs. 47,000/- plus HRA for Research Associate-I and Rs. 37,000/- or Rs. 30,000/- plus HRA for Project Associate-I.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years for both posts. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date for determining eligibility for age, experience and essential qualification. Experience, where required, must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: All candidates must deposit their mobile phone along with valid identity proof at the reception; it is returned only after the entire selection process is complete. These are short-term positions. Extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the tenure of the project. Appointees have no claim for regularization. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University. Candidates must satisfy themselves about the minimum eligibility criteria before appearing; no query on eligibility will be entertained. All results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and all communications will be made only through email. content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: THSTI is the institute whose NCR Biotech Science Cluster campus at Faridabad is the walk-in venue. The notice invites applicants for two project-linked research posts, signed by the Head-Administration. Matters not covered in the notice are governed by the bye-laws of THSTI and Government of India rules and guidelines.

They will be entitled to the emoluments of Project Associate-II, i.e. Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA. Walk-in date: 23 November 2026. Age limit: 35 years. Rs. 30,000/- + HRA applies to others who do not fall under (i) above. The age limit is 35 years for both posts. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date for determining eligibility for age, experience and essential qualification. Experience, where required, must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent will be involved in extensive cell culture, Western Blotting, ELISA and/or animal handling. Biochemical assays, enzyme inhibition assays Culturing in BSL-3 Animal handling Cloning and protein expression studies

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Latest CV/resume One set of photocopies of documents in support of educational qualification and experience, along with the originals A valid ID card, for verification

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates may walk in for a written test, skill test or interview at 9:00 am on the date mentioned against each post. Candidates coming after the time slot mentioned will not be entertained. If many candidates appear, screening will be done to limit the number to those with higher or relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q1. When is the THSTI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in is on 23 November 2026 for Project Associate-I and on 27 November 2026 for Research Associate-I, at 9:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the THSTI walk-in held?
faq.answer: It is held at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Research Associate-I and one Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: Ph.D. (awarded) in any branch of Life Sciences with at least one first-author research article in a reputed peer-reviewed journal. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis can also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A B.E./ B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for both posts, counted on the date of interview, with relaxations for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Government servants, Institute employees and ex-servicemen as listed above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Research Associate-I gets Rs. 47,000/- plus HRA. Project Associate-I gets Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA for NET/GATE or national-level examination-selected scholars, and Rs. 30,000/- plus HRA for others.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, every pay figure in the notice is stated as "plus HRA" (Rs. 30,000/- + HRA for the lower Project Associate-I rate).

faq.question: Q9. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring your latest CV/resume, one set of photocopies of educational qualification and experience documents with the originals, and a valid ID card.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. These are short-term positions, extension depends on satisfactory performance and project tenure, and appointees have no claim for regularization.
